facebookresearch_fairchem/src/fairchem/c.compute_energy_forces_within_threshold: compute the fraction of systems where energy error is below 0.02 and max force error is below 0.03

facebookresearch_fairchem/src/fairchem/c.run_ani1x_transform: run the ani1x_transform function to center a molecule in a periodic cell with fixed atoms
facebookresearch_fairchem/src/fairchem/c.run_qm9_transform: run the qm9_transform function to prepare QM9 molecular data with periodic boundary conditions
facebookresearch_fairchem/src/fairchem/c.run_decompose_tensor: run decompose_tensor to decompose a rank-2 tensor into irreducible representation components
facebookresearch_fairchem/src/fairchem/c.run_ensure_tensor: run ensure_tensor to convert specified attributes of an AtomicData object into PyTorch tensors
